name: Quarters, Living
description:
This suite features separate rooms to house a number of creatures equal to the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the **[Starship Size Suite Capacity](#Starship%20Size%20Suite%20Capacity)** table. Each room comes fully furnished and includes a communal refresher station for every four rooms (minimum of one).
When a creature completes a long rest involving this suite, their exhaustion level is reduced by 2, instead of only 1.
